FNO.scope: Recorded training_wall_seconds around historical epoch loop; includes validation and in-loop checkpoint handling; excludes initial data/model setup

MLP.scope: Observed session start to completion after initial data/model setup; includes validation and per-epoch NFS checkpoints

limitations: Shared CPU/GPU; affinity is not exclusive reservation
Only five complete-field repetitions; p95 is descriptive, not stable tail inference
CPU/GPU ratios are deployment comparisons, not pure algorithm acceleration
